title: new-project fleet conformance rule set
description: Read-only checks comparing a governed checkout's declarations against the repository they describe. Adding a check is data, not code: every rule names an implementation that scripts/fleet_conformance.py provides, and the test asserts the two sets match exactly.

code.description: Stable identifier; consumers filter on it, so it never changes meaning.

severity.description: An error means the declaration cannot describe this repository; a warning means it describes it incompletely.

check.description: Name of the implemented check this rule invokes.

subject.description: Repository-relative path the check reads, when the check reads exactly one.

identityField.description: Field in the subject that names the repository the instance claims to describe.

remediation.description: What to change, and why the declaration is not merely cosmetic.
